# Demo assets

The product illustrations, still-life illustration, and Harbor logos are original SVG fixtures for these demo sites, distributed under GPL-2.0-or-later with the project.

The three photographs and Manrope font are copied from WordPress Twenty Twenty-Five 1.5. The original theme credits are retained in `demo-theme/assets/twentytwentyfive-credits.txt`.

- `parthenon-square.webp`: Rhomaides Frères, Parthenon, circa 1880–1890; CC0; https://www.rawpixel.com/image/13759051
- `dallas-creek-square.webp`: Boyd Norton, Near East Dallas Creek, 1972; CC0; https://www.rawpixel.com/image/8802688
- `typewriter.webp`: Person typing on a typewriter; CC0; https://www.rawpixel.com/image/12240004/photo-image-face-person-technology
- Manrope: Copyright 2018 The Manrope Project Authors; SIL Open Font License 1.1; https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/manrope (full license: `demo-theme/assets/manrope-OFL.txt`)

Premium themes and plugins are not included in these fixtures.
